title: Freely specified codon frequencies
description: Supply a separate frequency for each codon, rather than deriving codon frequencies from nucleotide frequencies. By default, the frequencies are inferred jointly under a symmetric Dirichlet prior. The name refers to the 61 sense codons of the standard genetic code; the supplied alphabet determines the actual set of states.
